item.description:

item.title: 科学家制备稳定“硼石墨烯”并发现量子液晶态
item.description:
📚 Physics News
石墨烯虽被视为未来电子学的重要材料，但较弱的电子相互作用限制了其在高温超导等方向的潜力。东北大学研究团队在三维晶体表面制备出稳定的“硼石墨烯”，克服了长期存在的稳定性难题，并观察到新的量子态。该量子液晶态可能为更低能耗电子器件提供材料与物理基础。

item.title: 融合 RBF 网络与超螺旋扩张状态观测器的 SPMSM 固定时间积分滑模控制
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Rongfei Pan, Aimin An, Bo Yu, Chenchen Wang, Qiaoling Yang
该文针对表贴式永磁同步电机驱动系统中由模型不确定性、参数扰动和外部负载扰动导致的调速性能退化问题，提出一种复合控制策略。方法结合 RBF 神经网络、固定时间积分终端滑模控制器和超螺旋扩张状态观测器，实现内部不确定性在线逼近、外部扰动估计与前馈补偿。Lyapunov 分析用于证明闭环固定时间稳定性；多工况仿真表明该策略可提高动态响应和鲁棒性，并抑制滑模抖振。

item.title: 撒哈拉以南非洲面板数据中机器学习与计量模型的通胀预测评估
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Baffour Osei, Abigail Boatemaa, Isaac Nyame, Gabriel Osei Forkuo
该研究构建了八个撒哈拉以南非洲经济体 1972—2024 年年度宏观面板数据，用于比较随机游走、线性计量模型、Elastic Net、随机森林、XGBoost 和 LSTM 等通胀预测方法。基于时间顺序训练/验证/测试划分和 Diebold-Mariano 检验，结果显示没有任何估计模型在统计意义上显著优于简单的持久性基准。随机森林、XGBoost、Elastic Net 和采用早停的 LSTM 与随机游走大致持平，而传统线性模型和未校正 LSTM 表现显著更差。

It allows the user to bypass the process of deciphering the mean-field form for each many-body Hamiltonian H and thus avoid setting up a tailored program for each H. Rather, autohf finds the optimal Slater determinant |Ψångle, written in terms of orbital coefficients and subject to symmetry constraints, by directly minimizing the variational energy łangle H ångle. By embracing this variational approach, autohf makes use of the growing power of automatic differentiation and optimization tools developed by the machine learning community.

item.title: Long-lived memory in sliding spin chains
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Charles Stahl, Ethan Lake
arXiv:2607.14383v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a system of two ferromagnetic one-dimensional Ising chains coupled to a thermal bath, which are driven out of equilibrium by being moved past one another at a constant speed. We show that even at modest speeds, magnetic friction between the two chains significantly increases the ability of the system to order. In particular, at inverse temperature β, Ising coupling J, and sliding speed v, the dynamics retains memory of its initial magnetization for a time that increases from exp(O(β J)) at v = 0 to exp(O((β J)²vłn v)) when v>v_c, where v_c is a small constant. Magnetic friction thus provides a simple mechanism for parametrically slowing down thermalization in a one-dimensional magnet.

item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Masayuki Ohzeki
arXiv:2607.14917v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a duality analysis in conjunction with the star-triangle transformation for symmetric-group permutation models on the triangular and honeycomb lattices. The calculation is motivated by the permutation-model description of random tensor networks and by earlier duality analyses of replicated spin glasses.
